method: manual independent symbolic proof and three existing-agent adversarial reviews

new_proof_obligations.fixed_bias_bracket: [-2V,2V] gives constant -V and +V controls, whose endpoints strictly bracket h for T>tmin

new_proof_obligations.root_uniqueness: equal terminal h for ordered biases forces identical controls; continuous common control taking only saturation values must be constant, contradiction
new_proof_obligations.continuous_root_selection: compact fixed bias interval, joint continuity, unique target root
new_proof_obligations.cost_continuity: uniform control continuity implies L1 then uniform state and cost continuity
new_proof_obligations.all_interior_costs: choose opposite sides from C042 sharp families; apply IVT on exact-terminal path
new_proof_obligations.T_equals_tmin: unique constant V control; singleton cost; no unique bias root claim
